methodologyNotes: Roster covers nine high-search digital kitchen scale models spanning budget through prosumer tiers: OXO Good Grips Stainless Steel (pull-out display), Escali Primo P115, Greater Goods (Nourish/Nutrition backlit), KitchenAid KQ909, Etekcity EK6015, My Weigh KD-8000, Zwilling Enfinigy, Ozeri Pronto ZK14, and Nicewell 22lb. Specs independently re-verified against manufacturer product pages (oxo.com, escaliusa.com/atbbq.com, shop.greatergoods.com, etekcity.com, zwilling.com, ozeri.com, hbitech.com) and major retail/review listings (Amazon, Walmart, Home Depot, Tom's Guide, thecookingworld.com, scalesplus.com, toolsandtoys.net). precision_g in grams (standard metric increment); max_weight_kg in kilograms; booleans reflect manufacturer/authoritative-review yes/no; dishwasher_safe=false recorded when manufacturer states wipe/hand-wash only, true only when a removable platform is explicitly dishwasher-safe, null when unstated. Prices are published US prices for the exact model/config named; where no live USD price could be confirmed, priceUsd=null. accessedAt 2026-06-15.
